title: Savings clause.
bodyText: Except as provided in part 3, a transaction validly entered into before the effective date of this article and the rights, duties, and interests flowing from the transaction shall remain valid thereafter and may be terminated, completed, consummated, or enforced as required or permitted by law other than this chapter or, if applicable, this chapter, as though this article had not taken effect.
bodyHtml:
PART 2.  GENERAL TRANSITIONAL PROVISION

 

     [§490:13-201]  Savings clause.  Except as provided in part 3, a transaction validly entered into before the effective date of this article and the rights, duties, and interests flowing from the transaction shall remain valid thereafter and may be terminated, completed, consummated, or enforced as required or permitted by law other than this chapter or, if applicable, this chapter, as though this article had not taken effect. [L 2023, c 132, pt of §1]
